# Load Metadata
```{r} 
MERLIN_QCD <- readRDS("./Project_MERLIN/Analysis/Household_transmission/2025-04-08_final_metadata/results/MERLIN_metadata_041525.RDS")

cfreundii <-  MERLIN_QCD %>% subset(Species =="Citrobacter freundii") %>% .$Sample %>% sort %>% paste0(.,"_R1.fastq.gz")
writeLines(cfreundii,"./Project_MERLIN/Sequence_data/variant_calling/2025-04-15_SNPKIT/cfreundii/cfreundii_samples.txt")
``` 
